notes.title: Patch 1.2.2_EA
notes.notes:
List of changes


 All bg images was compressed to reduce their weight and optimize them.
 Fixed a small bug in the language change interface.
 Languages are now dynamic and are added to the list as long as they are available in the “translations/*” folder.
 Now people who want to create “fan translations” or “community translations” will be able to generate the translation files from within the game. (see questions and answers).
 Added support for downloading packages (translations etc) (see questions and answers).
 Some unused lines of code have been removed
 Upgraded the engine to R8.4-n (nightly version of the engine)
 Due to the engine update, the game can no longer run on versions later than windows 10. This will adjust the support for w10 & w11 and thus fully enforce the requirements placed on the Steam page. 
 The “Load” button will appear in the main menu when there is a saved game in one of the page slots. However, it will not be visible if it is in quick save.



Q&A

> Can I create translations? 
Yes, you can now create translations independent of the game. To generate a “translation kit” you must go to Settings -> language -> Generate translator kit. 

 Important: The translation reference will only be generated in Latin Spanish due to limitations.


> Can I freely share the translation?
Yes, as long as you are not receiving money in return or using it commercially also as you follow the EULA

> What do you mean by downloading packages?
This means that, if a translator wishes, he/she can request to have his/her fan translation added to the game. The translator will have to send the files and a nickname to be added to the game, the files will be hosted on the UnSetSoft server and then players will be able to download the translation from the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37549194/9296b0294d766382cfa549ba0c6914220e1075b2.png

 At the moment the option to download packages is disabled. 

> Why was support for older versions of windows removed?
It is due to changes in the libraries that the game needs to run, on the other hand the Steam client requires at least windows 10 to run.

notes.title: Patch notes for 1.1.0_EA
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0_EA is now available, this update brings the English translation without native fixes. Lately I've been asked about the status of the translation, so while the translation is being fixed I decided to publish this fix. First of all, the translation was created by Suki and corrected by MaryZ and is being corrected to native by Claire (NoraNekoGames) so thank you very much for doing the translation! The next patch will include the English language corrections that are pending.
 

List of changes


 added English language
 added new GUI
 added archivements
 code optimization
 game engine update to R8.2.2


Note about the Japanese translation: The translation has errors, however, corrections will be paused until a proper translation can be made. My Japanese is not very good and I still have a lot to learn, it took me 5 years to get the basics and I still struggle to express myself in Japanese. The dictionary did not help me well to do the translation, so I hope in the future to find someone to translate from English to Japanese, but for the time being the corrections for the Japanese translation will be paused.
